letters.name: ए
letters.pronunciationNote: like the French é; e.g., étude

letters.name: अं
letters.pronunciationNote: a nasalized vowel exact pronunciation is context-dependent

letters.name: अः
letters.pronunciationNote: an extra puff of air following a vowel (aspirated)

letters.name: क
letters.pronunciationNote: “k” in kit; use minimal to no breath

letters.name: ख
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of क ka. Similar to the German `ch` sound in Bach--slightly less aspirated, though.

letters.name: घ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of ग ga; like “g-h” in big-house

letters.name: च
letters.pronunciationNote: “ch” in cheese; use minimal to no breath

letters.name: छ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of च ca; “ch” in 'watch out' or 'pitch-hook'

letters.name: झ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of ज ja; like “ge h” in large house

letters.name: ट
letters.pronunciationNote: like “t” in tarp/train but harder; not aspirated

letters.name: ठ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of ठ ṭa; like “t-h” in shirt-hanger

letters.name: ड
letters.pronunciationNote: “d” in disk but harder; not aspirated

letters.name: ढ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of ड ḍa; like “dh” in roundhouse

letters.name: त
letters.pronunciationNote: like “t” in the phrase “at the”; not aspirated

letters.name: ध
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of द da; as in breadth or Aadhar ;)

letters.name: प
letters.pronunciationNote: “p” in space; use minimal breath; not aspirated

letters.name: फ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of प pa;like “p-h” in hip-hop or Phantom

letters.name: भ
letters.pronunciationNote: aspirated form of ब ba; like “bh” in subheading

letters.name: य
letters.pronunciationNote: as in 'yet' or 'young', but les tense

letters.name: ष
letters.pronunciationNote: a retroflex sibilant pronounced similarly to श śa; appears only in Sanskrit loanwords
